findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property in align-items mixin
findings.body: The new `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items: $alignment;`, which is not a valid CSS property. The only IE10-prefixed property for alignment is `-ms-flex-align` (already emitted on line 120). The invalid `-ms-align-items` declaration is silently ignored by browsers and is dead CSS.

findings.title: Invalid -moz-inline-box value in inline-flex mixin
findings.body: The new `inline-flex` mixin emits `display: -moz-inline-box;`, but Firefox never implemented an inline variant of its legacy `-moz-box` model — only the block-level `-moz-box` existed. The declaration is a no-op and adds noise; consumers of this mixin on legacy Gecko get neither the legacy flex nor a working inline-flex because `-moz-box` (the only Moz box value) is not emitted.

findings.title: Invalid -webkit-order property in order mixin
findings.body: The new `order` mixin emits `-webkit-order: $val;`, which is not a CSS property that any WebKit-based browser has ever shipped. The legacy WebKit property is `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` (already emitted on line 126). The `-webkit-order` declaration is dead CSS and should be removed.

findings.title: Trailing whitespace inside align-items mixin
findings.body: Line 120 (`-ms-flex-align: $alignment;  `) contains trailing whitespace after the semicolon. While cosmetic, it will appear verbatim in every compiled stylesheet that uses this mixin and is inconsistent with the rest of the file.
